traceability.notes: The 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT story is fully implemented. Core parsing and format validation for @supports are in the valid-annotation-format helpers, deep requirement validation for @supports (including multi-story, shared IDs, and per-story scoping) is in valid-req-reference-helpers, and both require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation rules are updated to treat @supports as satisfying their respective requirements while maintaining backward compatibility with @story/@req. Mixed usage in the same comment/file is explicitly supported and tested. Error messages for missing requirements include the checked story path. The Jest suite includes dedicated tests referencing this story and all such tests pass. User documentation (migration guide and README) describes @supports usage and migration, satisfying the documentation acceptance criterion. Therefore, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are met with concrete, passing tests and aligned documentation.
